project: VerseWell — public Bible REST API + reading website

stack.site: Cloudflare Pages (static, dogfoods the public API)
constraints: Free tier only, end to end
No custom domain — production URLs are *.pages.dev and *.workers.dev
Operator works entirely from Android phone (Termux + browser dashboards) — no local CLI assumptions in docs

source_data.note: Church-produced Bible translations as .sqlite files. Redistribution rights confirmed by operator. Do NOT add non-church translations without flagging for operator confirmation.

tasks.title: Create public GitHub repo vjumbo264/versewell, seed BUILD_STATE.json, verify push
tasks.notes: Repo vjumbo264/versewell created via GitHub API (public, main). Seed commit pushed and verified: local HEAD == origin/main == ccea03bdd56f4889ba8274e5827e7252984c36f2. Push access proven.

tasks.title: Inventory Drive folder .sqlite files; inspect each file's actual schema; document in ARCHITECTURE.md
tasks.notes: Inventoried Drive folder 1DWkrc33kGOCTR0LFZhMzANFi_IryA5wn via public embeddedfolderview + uc?export=download. 11 valid SQLite files: amp, cev, gw, kjv, msg(.db), niv2011, nkjv, nlt, nlv, tlb, voice. Common schema: books/verses(verse=REAL chapter.fff)/annotations/chapters/metadata. Quirks verified: CEV verses shifted +1 chapter (John 4.016 = John 3:16 text) + 66 book-intros as Xxx.int chapters; MSG merged sparse verses (13,118 rows); fen-N annotation link uses global per-book verse counter (AMP Gen 2:4 = fen-AMP-35a); annotation styles: fen-*/cen-* (BibleGateway) vs !f./!x. (USFM, CEV/KJV/MSG); leading section headings embedded in unformatted text. Full per-file table documented in ARCHITECTURE.md §1.

tasks.title: Design + commit unified D1 schema (versions, verses, footnotes, section_intros); document source→unified mapping in ARCHITECTURE.md
tasks.notes: Unified D1 schema committed as schema.sql (versions/verses/footnotes/section_intros + lookup indexes). Source-to-unified mapping incl. all per-file quirks documented in ARCHITECTURE.md §2. Versions keyed by uppercased metadata.name code (AMP, CEV, GW, KJV, MSG, NIV2011, NKJV, NLT, NLV, TLB, VOICE). CEV chapter-1 shift applied on import; cen-/!x. cross-references skipped (footnotes only).

tasks.title: Create /bible-sources/ folder, copy each .sqlite into it, build import/migration script (sqlite file → unified D1 schema, incl. footnotes + section_intros)
tasks.notes: Import pipeline operational for all 10 present files. Two real blockers found+fixed: (1) CEV source has two rows for Mark 17.009 (= Mark 16:9 after chapter shift) — PK collision, fixed with first-row-wins dedup; (2) MSG merged paragraphs made a single 400-row INSERT exceed D1's per-statement limit (SQLITE_TOOBIG) — fixed by batching emit() on both row count (<=100) AND accumulated bytes (<=60KB). Regenerated: max statement ~60KB (was >900KB), 0 duplicate PKs.

tasks.title: Create Cloudflare D1 database + Pages project via API; connect GitHub auto-deploy; set up Actions workflow with auto-import of new/changed /bible-sources/ files on deploy
tasks.notes: D1 versewell-db + Pages project versewell created; worker config, GHA deploy workflow and deploy_pages.sh committed. Blocking bug being fixed in task-04: partial CEV import in D1 must be re-applied after the dedup fix; then worker/pages deploy steps can run. GH Actions secrets must be confirmed present (import step ran in CI, so secrets exist).

decisions.decision: Import footnotes only (fen-*/!f.); skip cross-references (cen-*/!x.) for now.
decisions.reason: Prompt requires footnotes + section intros; cross-refs are in the explicit do-not-build-yet list.

decisions.decision: CEV book introductions stored as section_intros at chapter=1 spanning all of chapter 1.
decisions.reason: CEV is the only source with intros; they are book-level, so they render as the bordered block before chapter 1.

decisions.decision: Leading section-heading lines inside verses.unformatted are stripped on import (not exposed separately yet).
decisions.reason: Keeps verse text clean for API consumers; heading extraction can be a later enhancement.

decisions.decision: Hold voice.sqlite3 out of the initial 10-version import; add it back via the normal /bible-sources/ flow during task-11.
decisions.reason: Gives a genuine end-to-end demonstration of the auto-import mechanism using a real source file.

resume_from: task-05/06: commit+push the import.py dedup fix; the triggered deploy re-imports (DELETE-then-INSERT per version) and then deploys worker+pages; verify live; then task-06 row-count verification.
